pages.text:
Jay Obernolte for Congress
Conservative for California's 23rd Congressional District
Proven. Conservative. Fighter.
## Fix the Economy
Jay has spent three decades as a job creator. He knows that cutting spending and taxes will drive down inflation and grow the economy.
## Secure the Border
Human and drug trafficking have increased in our community. To combat this, Jay is fighting to secure the border.
## Keep us Safe
Violent crime and murders are increasing. Jay is working to support law enforcement and crack down on violent crime.
## Honor our Veterans
Jay has always fought for our veterans and he is getting results in Congress.
## Protect Taxpayers
Jay is fighting against wasteful spending and harmful tax increases. He knows we pay enough taxes and we can’t afford more debt.
## Defend America
Jay is working to protect our supply chains from cyberattacks and supporting our national defense.
## Endorsements

Big Bear Lake Mayor Rick Herrick
Victorville Mayor Debra Jones

Yucaipa Mayor Pro Tem Justin Beaver

pages.title: Obernolte Named to Leadership Position – Jay Obernolte for Congress
pages.text:
Jay Obernolte for Congress
Conservative for California's 8th Congressional District
## Obernolte Named to Leadership Position
You are here:
- Obernolte Named to Leadership Position
Story appeared on: http://www.vvdailypress.com/article/20160105/NEWS/160109890
Assemblyman Jay Obernolte, R-Hesperia, was named Tuesday to a leadership position in the state Assembly.
Obernolte, who represents the High Desert, was named an assistant Republican leader by Assembly Republican Leader Chad Mayes, of Yucca Valley.
Mayes announced his leadership team for the upcoming legislative session, naming eight other GOP lawmakers from the Assembly Republican Caucus to top positions.
As an assistant Republican leader, Obernolte “will work closely with members and staff to identify and recommend options to maximize caucus opportunities,” Mayes’ office said in a statement.

Congressman Jay Obernolte
## On the Issues
Our Congressman, Jay Obernolte is fighting for our values in Washington D.C.
## Fighting Washington’s Spending
Jay Obernolte is fighting to balance the federal budget and stop the reckless spending that is driving inflation and increasing prices
## Helping Working Families
Jay Obernolte fought to lower taxes, repeal gas taxes & lower fuel costs for commuters, provide tax relief for small businesses, and expand the child tax credit for working families
## Keeping us Safe
Jay Obernolte authored legislation to hold fentanyl dealers accountable for poisoning our children and stopped the dumping of sexual predators in our community to protect local families .
## Honoring Our Veterans
Jay Obernolte fought to expand coverage for veterans who were exposed to toxic burn pits and is leading efforts to hold the VA accountable
## Strengthening America
Jay Obernolte voted to fully fund our military, and to give a pay raise to our troops who are defending our freedoms.
## Secure the border
Jay Obernolte voted for the strongest border security bill ever. He wants to finish the border wall and increase the number of border patrol agents to stop drug trafficking.
About Our Congressman, Jay Obernolte
## proven.
Jay Obernolte isn’t a career politician. He’s a business owner who has created hundreds of good, high-paying local jobs. From fighting Washinton’s inflationary spending, cracking down on drug traffickers, working to provide relief to our families, keeping our community safe, and standing strong for our veterans, Jay is working for us. Jay is running for Congress to continue fighting for the conservative values we care about and deliver on the issues that matter to our families.
Jay has lived in California’s 23rd Congressional District for over 25 years. He earned a bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering from Caltech, a master’s degree in Artificial Intelligence from UCLA, and a doctorate in Public Administration from CalBaptist University. In 1990 Jay started FarSight Studios, a software development company, in his college dorm room. Since then he has created hundreds of jobs in our community. While running a successful business, Jay and his wife Heather also raised their two sons, Hale and Troy.
Jay also has 19 years of experience in public service. He was first elected to a local airport board in 2005, followed by 4 years of service on a city council and two terms as Mayor of the City of Big Bear Lake. In 2014 he was elected to the California State Assembly where he served us with distinction. In 2020 he was elected to represent us in Congress, and he has been fighting for us ever since..
In Congress, Jay has used his background as a tech entrepreneur to draft and pass legislation to update our cyber security in response to the cyberterror attacks that shut down some of our critical supply chains. In response to out-of-control government spending that has created the worst inflation in decades, Jay authored legislation to force the federal government to balance its budget and cut wasteful spending.
Jay is also a committed volunteer. He uses his pilot’s license to volunteer with the Veterans Airlift Command, providing free transportation to wounded and disabled veterans. He is also a 5th degree black belt in Pacific Unified Martial Arts and teaches children self-defense to this day.
Jay understands the challenges and opportunities of the 23rd Congressional District. He is passionate about taking his record of creating jobs and his success as a legislator to Washington DC with the goal of improving the quality of life for all Americans.
## Endorsements
